goal: Add appearance storage to Character - persist skin tone, armor colors, eye color as part of character data in rpg-api repository layer
design_decisions: Appearance is cosmetic data - belongs in API layer, not toolkit
Store appearance separately from character/draft JSON (separate Redis keys)
Add methods to existing repos rather than creating separate appearance repo
Appearance flows: draft creation -> finalize -> character storage
Post-creation editing will be supported later
next_steps: Wire up orchestrator to handle appearance in draft flow
Wire appearance into Finalize flow (copy from draft to character)
